Bill.BriefDescription: Permitting the placement of human trafficking informational posters in rest areas.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permitting the placement of human traffickinginformational posters in rest areas; and adding a new section tochapter 47.38 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.38 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department may work with human trafficking victim advocates indeveloping informational posters for placement in rest areas. Thedepartment may adopt policies for the placement of these posters inrest areas and these policies must address, at a minimum, placement ofthe posters in bathroom stalls. The posters may be in a variety oflanguages and include tollfree telephone numbers a person may call forassistance, including the number for the national human traffickingresource center at (888)3737888 and the number for the Washingtonstate office of crime victims advocacy at (800)8221067.
